rules.description: NIC must segregate applications by state and scheme from a merit list to create lots.
rules.condition: When processing scholarship applications for lot generation.
rules.outcome: Applications are divided state‑wise and scheme‑wise and lots are created.
rules.evidence_quote: NIC will segregate the applications, state-wise and scheme-wise, from a merit list to create lots.

rules.description: NIC must incorporate beneficiary‑ids received from PFMS into each record of the lot.
rules.condition: During lot creation after segregation of applications.
rules.outcome: Each record in the lot includes the corresponding beneficiary‑id from PFMS.
rules.evidence_quote: NIC will incorporate beneficiary-ids received from PFMS against each record and push these lots to PFMS over a secured channel for creation of payment files.

rules.description: NIC must push the created lots to PFMS over a secured channel for payment file generation.
rules.condition: After beneficiary‑ids have been incorporated into each record.
rules.outcome: Lots are transmitted securely to PFMS to create payment files.
rules.evidence_quote: NIC will incorporate beneficiary-ids received from PFMS against each record and push these lots to PFMS over a secured channel for creation of payment files.

rules.description: All lot‑generation activities must be finished by a specific deadline.
rules.outcome: Activities are completed no later than 25th October 2017.
rules.evidence_quote: These activities will be completed by 25th October, 2017 for all three scholarship schemes.
